levelDescriptions.OBSERVE: Can look but not touch: screenshots, window and system information, and reading files inside the folders you allow.
levelDescriptions.ASSIST: Can control the mouse and keyboard, open applications, run commands and change files. Risky actions ask first.
levelDescriptions.AUTONOMOUS: Runs approved tools without asking each time. Destructive and security-related actions still require confirmation.
